title: Bank-Draft (ACH) Payments of Resident Coinsurance under Medicare Part A Skilled Nursing Facility Coverage
content:
A resident covered by Medicare Part A Skilled Nursing Facility Coverage, or the representative, may pay the resident's coinsurance by authorizing a bank draft — an electronic debit (ACH) from their own checking or savings account — during the call. A bank-draft payment is applied to the resident's original coinsurance charge for the coverage's latest booked coinsurance block, and the bank draft is the amount that settles the resident's share of that block not yet paid.

**When a bank draft may be taken.** A bank-draft payment toward a resident coinsurance charge is not taken until the records carry, against that charge, a reduction for every uncertified-day reversal posted against its booked-days entry after the charge itself was posted and taking back days that take a resident share above nothing under the split in effect on them.

Whether a bank draft may be taken at all is settled by the base posting rule, which this policy leaves unchanged: once the resident has had the returned-payment limit of dishonored payments within the rolling lookback of calendar months ending on the payment date, only certified funds are accepted from the resident on any coverage episode, so no bank draft is taken; this policy prices the bank draft only where one may be taken.

## Payment tool: `pay_coinsurance_by_bank_draft_32bb229d`

**Capability.** Records one bank-draft payment by the resident or the representative, authorized from their own checking or savings account during the call, dated today and applied to the one named resident coinsurance charge; it lowers the episode's open coinsurance balance by the amount paid, and the payer sees the payment on the resident's account immediately.

**How it is invoked.** This is a customer-side tool: the agent unlocks it and hands it over, and the customer themselves — the resident or the representative — runs it to authorize the draft.

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `medicare_coverage_id` | The reference number of the Medicare Part A coverage episode the charge belongs to, as the business office reads it from the resident's coverage episode | Id |
| `charge_entry_id` | The reference number of the resident coinsurance charge entry being paid, as the business office reads it from the episode's Medicare billing history and gives it to the payer | Id |
| `amount` | The amount drafted from the payer's account | USD, 2 decimal places, positive, passed already rounded to the cent |

**Return.** On success the receipt reads: status "paid" (the bank-draft payment now stands on the account); the payment entry's reference number; the charge the payment is applied to; payment method "ach"; the amount paid; today's date (YYYY-MM-DD); and the episode's open coinsurance balance across every liable party including this payment. A non-positive amount returns an error.
